title: What Super Agers Reveal About Preventing Disease

reader_summary.headline: We have a path to preventing disease.
reader_summary.overview: We have a path to preventing disease. It's just preventing the age-related morbidities of the big three. If we can keep people healthier, healthier people would be much less expensive. Seven years more of health span, three of the major three diseases.

thesis: The podcast argues that the path to preventing disease lies not in reversing aging, but in preventing the age-related morbidities of the 'big three': cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative conditions. It posits that these diseases are preventable through lifestyle factors and new technologies like AI and omics, which allow for intelligent partitioning of risk and better health outcomes.
